docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Bengali Gītāñjali of Rabindranath Tagore (1861–1941), first published in 1910: 157 songs and poems, most of them written in 1909 and 1910. About fifty of them are among the 103 poems of his English Song Offerings (1912), which is on the shelf Classics in Translation. The text of the edition of 1913, as proofread on Bengali Wikisource; each poem is a chapter, named by its first line.

From Wikisource · Public domain

Rabindranath Tagore (1861–1941), Gītāñjali (1910; edition of 1913), as proofread on Bengali Wikisource by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain.
